title.description: Name shown at the top of the register, such as the family or clan name.

subtitle.description: One line under the title. Leave empty to hide it.

sample.description: Set true only for the bundled example. Remove it, or set false, for your own family.

focusId.description: Id of the person the tree opens on.

lang.description: Language of the page, such as en or ur.

dir.description: Set rtl if the register should read right to left.

id.description: Stable short id. Other people point at this. Do not change it once it is used. Example: yusuf.

name.description: Name as it should appear on the tree.

living.description: True if alive, false if deceased. If omitted, a death date means deceased.

birth.description: Free text, usually a year. Examples: 1954, 1954-03, c. 1890.

death.description: Free text. Leave empty for a living person.

place.description: A city, village, or other short place.

photo.description: Path of a small face photo, such as photos/yusuf.jpg. About 256×256, under 30KB.

bio.description: A few sentences. This is the whole biography the page shows.

gender.description: Used only for son or daughter in the caption. Safe to omit.

kind.description: Omit or person for people. Use pet for cats, dogs, and other animals.

species.description: For pets only. Chooses the default avatar when there is no photo.

owners.description: For pets only. Ids of the people who keep this pet.

father.description: Id of the father, if recorded. Do not use on pets.

mother.description: Id of the mother, if recorded. Do not use on pets.

spouses.description: Ids of spouses. A spouse listed on only one person is still linked.
